selected_model3:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ONE radically art-directed full-page DESKTOP website design for LA DÉPENDANCE — ONGLES & REGARD, Pontchâteau, model 3 "LE PASSAGE". Long portrait website, no device frame, no model label.
INPUT1: client GLOW concept gives tall HEAVY condensed uppercase letters, photographic human subject crossing the type, small handwritten phrase. Copy that typographic force, NEVER its orange colours or skincare jar. INPUT2: actual new LD logo. Preserve monogram, accented LA DÉPENDANCE wordmark, ONGLES & REGARD descriptor. INPUT3: real studio interior (terracotta reception, gold mirrors, wood floor, white shelves and plants). Preserve recognisable real architecture. INPUT4: real bright fuchsia floral manicure photo with milky pink/white base and small petals; preserve the exact manicure artwork and believable hand anatomy. INPUT5: real studio team photograph with tattooed woman in white/blue t-shirt and woman in ivory hijab; preserve both real people, their clothes/head covering/tattoos, no invented staff.
COLOURS: deep PLUM #3D2435; IVORY #F5EFE7; mineral ROSE #D4B4BB; muted MAUVE #9E6874. Actual photo colours remain natural. This is the SAME new identity as the logo, not an alternate colour brand.
CREATIVE STRUCTURE: a flowing photographic journey organised by ONE large elegant LD/D-shaped aperture which opens from hero into the next photo. Avoid the obvious five rectangular bands and repeated title/photo template. Some edges are straight, one has a precisely shaped D corner, one is crossed by a life-size photographic hand. No generic wavy separators, no scrapbook, no framed cards. Only ONE main flat colour background scene, mineral rose. All other scenes are photographic backgrounds, including photographed ivory studio backdrops with real light/shadow.
SIX SCENES:
1 HERO about 30% page height: large extremely elegant realistic beauty campaign photo of an adult woman, face/eyes and beautifully manicured hand visible, thoughtful confident gaze, dark hair loosely tied, neutral cream clothing. Natural skin texture, no airbrushed AI face. Body positioned RIGHT inside the open counter of a giant softly lit matte PLUM D/LD sculptural doorway, physically plausible studio prop, not a giant cosmetics product. The monogram doorway is cropped through right edge and partly extends beyond lower boundary. Left HUGE condensed PLUM headline "À PART." on warm ivory PHOTOGRAPHIC backdrop with a very real soft window shadow. One small handwritten phrase above "votre beauté". Clear small line "La beauté des ongles et du regard, à Pontchâteau." Minimal top navigation with correct LD logo left, "Ongles / Regard / L’institut", outlined "PRENDRE RENDEZ-VOUS ↗" right. Primary plum text action "RÉSERVER SUR PLANITY ↗" lower left. The portrait and D edge overlap some letters, sophisticated foreground/background depth similar to GLOW. Campaign model is not a named staff member. The right curved doorway opens smoothly onto second scene's real interior without a wave.
2 FULL-PHOTO real interior from INPUT3, presented as a broad panorama revealed through the continuation of D edge from above. Use actual terracotta desk, gold frames and green plants unaltered. A very large clean ivory heading "UNE ADRESSE. / VOTRE PARENTHÈSE." in left darker region; discreet small "La Dépendance · Au sein de La Maison B". No fake luxury spa or invented treatment room. A thin almond curve from LD is used as a precise reveal mask, not an ornamental wave.
3 SINGLE FLAT MINERAL-ROSE scene. Enormous PLUM display type "À CHACUNE / SON ÉCLAT." in a surprising asymmetric composition with lots of empty space. Smaller open inline service labels "Onglerie / Beauté du regard / Maquillage semi-permanent" arranged along one fine straight rule, with a clean underlined action "DÉCOUVRIR LES PRESTATIONS ↗". Tiny LD monogram as a typographic punctuation, not a giant badge. No boxes, cards, numbered directory, diagonal menu or duplicated two-column template.
4 PORTFOLIO scene is the real fuchsia floral manicure photo INPUT4 as an entire background, life-size fingernails visible in a deliberate macro crop, a foreground fingertip crosses the lower scene edge slightly. Huge IVORY three-line word sequence "DESSINER. / SOULIGNER. / RÉVÉLER." at the FAR LEFT against clear naturally dark margins; do not obscure the actual nail art. Fine tiny label "Ongles & regard". Full image-driven editorial, not a gallery row. Respect real colour and skin.
5 SHORT documentary photographic moment using real team INPUT5, wide crop, enough of both real smiling women, tattooed arm and ivory hijab to recognise the original. Tiny ivory headline "Le sens du détail. Le plaisir du lien." placed on a subtle dark margin, faces not covered. No invented name attribution. This is not a testimonial or a third-party stock photo.
6 FINAL BOOKING SCENE uses the client's phone-background idea in a believable beauty-studio STILL-LIFE PHOTOGRAPH: an elegantly manicured natural hand holding a large real smartphone at slight 12-degree angle over a warm ivory surface, blurred terracotta/plum studio mood behind. The phone screen is a VERY SIMPLE illustrative booking page with only "Planity", "La Dépendance" and "Prendre rendez-vous". No fake app-store button, fictitious application, QR code, medical information, fake availability, rates or invented real UI details. Huge condensed PLUM words "VOTRE / MOMENT." are behind the phone and hand. Short line "Choisissez votre rendez-vous sur Planity." One clear plum action "PRENDRE RENDEZ-VOUS ↗". Address "22 Grande Rue · 44160 Pontchâteau", Instagram "@ladependance_beauteduregard", tiny accurate LD footer all on same photographed background. No additional solid footer panel.
TYPE consistent tall monumental heavy condensed sans (GLOW-like), small clean neutral body sans and sparing hand-script only once. NOT thin serif beauty brand. French throughout, exact accents. High-end credible photography, restrained realistic material/skin quality. No fake own-brand cream/serum line, no orange, no stock awards, prices, hours, phone number or medical promises. The page must feel spatial and connected, especially monogram doorway hero->real room and foreground hand->booking, while keeping each scene visually distinct.

logo:

Descriptor (exact): "ONGLES & REGARD"
Primary request: Invent a distinct, contemporary, quietly premium identity, not a generic beauty logo. Above the wordmark, create a small extremely refined bespoke LD monogram: a clear upright L joins the curved bowl of a D, the counter gently resembles the elegant elongated outline of an almond nail, and one small curved inner stroke subtly evokes a closed eyelid. Only two or three precise geometric strokes total; no literal face, hand, bottle, hair, flower, crown or butterfly. No ornamental flourish or extra badge.
